tagline.zh: 24×24 是全行业共同祖先网格:展示区 24dp、活动区 20dp(四周 2dp padding)、方形键程 18×18、圆形键程 Ø20;栅格与安全区参考线实时可视化。
tagline.en: 24×24 is the industry's common ancestor grid: 24dp display, 20dp live area (2dp padding around), 18×18 square keyline, Ø20 circle keyline — the grid and safe-area guides visualized live.

origin.zh: 键程数值全部出自 Material 经典规范页 m2.material.io system-icons("System icons are displayed as 24 x 24 dp"、live area 20×20 with 2dp padding、Square 18×18、Circle Ø20、方形 16×20/横向 20×16,out/design-study/07-icons.md §2);Feather/Lucide 的 24×24 网格与 Heroicons 20/16 独立重绘网格为跨家族旁证(07 §1.2/§1.3)。
origin.en: All keyline numbers come from Material's classic spec page m2.material.io system-icons ("System icons are displayed as 24 x 24 dp", live area 20×20 with 2dp padding, Square 18×18, Circle Ø20, portrait 16×20 / landscape 20×16 — out/design-study/07-icons.md §2); Feather/Lucide's 24×24 grid and Heroicons' independently redrawn 20/16 grids serve as cross-family corroboration (07 §1.2/§1.3).

effect.zh: 绘制网格边长。24 = 官方基准:Material 展示区 24dp、Feather/Lucide/Heroicons 同规格(07 §0/§2);20 = Material 密集布局官方档("measurements may be scaled down to 20dp",活动区缩至 16×16),也是 Heroicons mini 的独立重绘网格(07 §1.3/§2);16 = Heroicons micro 独立重绘网格(实测 viewBox,07 §1.3);32 = 常见的放大倍增网格,官方无锚值(社区常见,未证实)。官方做法是「换尺寸档独立重绘」而非等比缩放(07 §3.1);demo 对非 24 档按 24 基准等比推导键程,仅供参考。
effect.en: Drawing-grid edge length. 24 = the official base: Material displays at 24dp and Feather/Lucide/Heroicons share the size (07 §0/§2); 20 = Material's official dense layout ("measurements may be scaled down to 20dp", live area down to 16×16) and Heroicons mini's redrawn grid (07 §1.3/§2); 16 = Heroicons micro's redrawn grid (viewBox measured, 07 §1.3); 32 = a common doubled-up grid with no official anchor (community norm, unverified). The official practice is redrawing at a new size tier, not proportional scaling (07 §3.1); the demo derives keylines for non-24 tiers proportionally from 24 — indicative only.

effect.zh: 活动区内边距(px,逐格整数步进以保持像素对齐)。官方定值 2:"Icon content is limited to the 20dp x 20dp live area, with 2dp of padding around the perimeter"(07 §2)。调到 0 时活动区吃满修剪区,内容会顶到画布边缘;官方补充:需要更强视觉重量时,内容可伸入 live area 与 trim area 之间的 padding,但绝不可出修剪区(07 §2)。
effect.en: Live-area inset (px, integer steps to keep pixel alignment). Official value 2: "Icon content is limited to the 20dp x 20dp live area, with 2dp of padding around the perimeter" (07 §2). At 0 the live area fills the trim area and content touches the canvas edge; per the spec, heavier content may extend into the padding between live and trim area, but never outside the trim area (07 §2).

note.zh: 栅格与键程是设计期概念,交付物是普通 SVG(viewBox 缩放),全主流浏览器一致渲染;demo 的参考线用 0.125 单位描边在 8 倍整数缩放下保持 1px 细线,无浏览器兼容问题。
note.en: Grid and keylines are design-time concepts; the deliverable is a plain SVG that scales by viewBox, rendered identically in all mainstream browsers. The demo's guide lines use 0.125-unit strokes at an 8× integer scale to stay 1px thin — no compatibility concerns.

fallback.zh: 无回退需求:栅格是创作规范而非运行时特性;验收时把参考线 SVG 关掉、只留图形本身,即得到真实交付形态。
fallback.en: No fallback needed: the grid is an authoring discipline, not a runtime feature; hide the guide SVG and keep the glyph itself to see the real deliverable.

use.zh: 自绘/评审图标时的验收底图:方形 18×18、圆形 Ø20、长方 20×16/16×20 四条键程逐一比对(07 §2)
use.en: Acceptance underlay for drawing/reviewing icons: compare against the four keylines — square 18×18, circle Ø20, landscape 20×16, portrait 16×20 (07 §2)

use.zh: 为桌面密集布局准备 20px 档位:展示区 20、活动区 16、padding 仍为 2(07 §2)
use.en: Preparing a 20px tier for dense desktop layouts: display 20, live 16, padding still 2 (07 §2)

use.zh: 跨图标集核对视觉重量:各家共用 24 祖先网格,键程铁律「圆比方大 2dp」是官方数值不是玄学(07 §3.1)
use.en: Cross-set weight checks: sets share the 24 ancestor grid, and the iron rule 'circle 2dp larger than square' is an official number, not folklore (07 §3.1)

avoid.zh: 把 24 网格图标等比硬缩到 16px 交付——官方做法是换档独立重绘(Heroicons 20/16 实测独立 viewBox,07 §1.3/§3.1)
avoid.en: Shipping a 24-grid icon scaled straight down to 16px — the official practice is an independently redrawn tier (Heroicons 20/16 measured standalone viewBoxes, 07 §1.3/§3.1)

avoid.zh: 内容出修剪区,或坐标出现小数——官方要求 X/Y 必须整数(「on pixel」,07 §2)
avoid.en: Content escaping the trim area, or fractional coordinates — the spec requires integer X/Y ("on pixel", 07 §2)

avoid.zh: padding 调到 0 还想保住呼吸感——活动区吃满后图标之间会视觉粘连
avoid.en: Setting padding to 0 and still expecting breathing room — a full-bleed live area makes icons visually glue together

a11y.zh: 栅格与可访问性间接相关:安全的活动区保证笔画间距,而 Lucide 规范要求相邻独立元素间隙 ≥2px、镂空里塞得进一个 2px 圆(07 §3.2)——间距过小会让小尺寸渲染糊成一片;参考线本身是装饰,交付物中不得出现(或标 aria-hidden)。
a11y.en: The grid relates to accessibility indirectly: a sane live area preserves stroke spacing, and Lucide's spec requires ≥2px gaps between adjacent independent elements plus a 2px circle fitting through every counter (07 §3.2) — too-tight spacing turns to mush when rendered small. Guides are decoration: never ship them in the deliverable (or mark them aria-hidden).

goal.zh: 在 24×24 栅格上绘制一个系统图标:内容限制在活动区(padding=2),对照方形 18×18 / 圆形 Ø20 键程,X/Y 坐标全整数,并提供 20px 密集档位。
goal.en: Draw a system icon on the 24×24 grid: content confined to the live area (padding=2), checked against the 18×18 square / Ø20 circle keylines, all X/Y integer, with a 20px dense tier.

acceptance.zh: 画布 24×24,内容不出修剪区,默认活动区 20×20(四周 2dp padding)
acceptance.en: Canvas 24×24, nothing outside the trim area, default live area 20×20 (2dp padding all around)

acceptance.zh: 方形元素贴 18×18 键程、圆形元素贴 Ø20 键程,长方形遵循 20×16 / 16×20
acceptance.en: Square elements follow the 18×18 keyline, circles the Ø20 keyline, rectangles 20×16 / 16×20

acceptance.zh: 全部 X/Y 坐标为整数(on pixel)
acceptance.en: All X/Y coordinates are integers (on pixel)

acceptance.zh: 提供 20px 密集档位(活动区 16×16)时重新核对手绘稿,而非等比缩放交付
acceptance.en: For a 20px dense tier (live 16×16), redraw from the master rather than scaling the 24px asset

acceptance.zh: 参考线仅用于验收,不出现在交付 SVG 中
acceptance.en: Guide lines exist for review only and never ship inside the deliverable SVG
